measurement.name: Algerian Current
measurement.range_interpretation: One reported regional along-slope width span; not annual extrema, a confidence interval, three autumn observations or a selected midpoint.
measurement.geographic_scope: Eastward along-slope Atlantic Water flow along the Algerian coast after leaving the Alboran Sea; no exact longitudinal terminal gates or paired width edges supplied.
measurement.section_orientation: No reproducible transverse section endpoints supplied for the introductory width description.
measurement.layer: Surface Atlantic Water regional flow; numerical width layer unresolved. Dataset sampling down to 975 m is not assigned as a width layer.
measurement.time_convention: Regional background synthesis in a 2019 article; no width occupation dates or calendar supplied. Autumn 2014-2016 describes the separate ABACUS survey dataset.
measurement.boundary_rule: Author-reported regional span, citing Testor et al. (2005). No paired edge positions or velocity cutoff extracted.
measurement.source_citation: Cotroneo, Aulicino, Ruiz, Sanchez Roman, Torner Tomas, Pascual, Fusco, Heslop, Tintore and Budillon (2019), Glider data collected during the Algerian Basin Circulation Unmanned Survey, Earth System Science Data 11, 147-161, doi:10.5194/essd-11-147-2019.
measurement.source_locator: Section 1 Introduction, printed p148 (PDF page 2), left column paragraph beginning with the Alboran Sea departure and citing Testor et al. (2005).
measurement.extraction_method: Numerical span transcribed from inspected publisher original prose; no glider, image or velocity-field boundary digitization.
measurement.source_quality_note: Original publisher PDF and p148 visually inspected. Introductory width cites prior work, not an ABACUS width calculation. Underlying Testor et al. boundary method remains unreviewed.
remaining_gates: Review the underlying width citation and paired boundary method.
Obtain compatible repeat sections before monthly or annual variation.
